notes.title: Long time no see...
notes.content:
[p][u][b]Hey everyone![/b][/u][/p][p][/p][p]I know it has been a loong time, but I'm working on a update for Retro Run!
This update will add some more content, changes to old content and some quality of life improvments :)[/p][p]But I was just wondering... what [b]you[/b] guys want to see in the new update?[/p][p]If you have any suggestions/feedback, please comment them![/p][p][/p][p]Hope you have an [b]awesome [/b]day/night![/p][p][/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p]- Vander / lilleBror[/p]

notes.title: Update alert!
notes.content:
[b]Hey all![/b]

Back again with some new fixes!
This update is mostly just tweaks to the movement to make it more snappy and less floaty, as some players felt it was too unresponsive. I have also tried making the game more fun instead of difficult. It will still be difficult, but more fun [i](at least in my opinion)[/i]

[b][u][i]What’s Adjusted?[/i][/u][/b]
Changed the gravity to combat “floatines”
Tweaked all the levels to fit the new movement

[b][u][i]What’s fixed?[/i][/u][/b]
Fixed a bug where the gun would freeze after firing a shot
Fixed a bug where the reload animation wouldn’t play if you reloaded immediately after firing a shot

[b][u][i]What’s new?[/i][/u][/b]
Visual feedback to collecting crystals
Added a outline to the viewmodel to make it stand out more

[i]Do you have any problem with these? bugs, glitches etc?
Please let me know, and I'll try my best to fix them![/i]

Hope you have an [b]awesome [/b]day/night!

Cheers,
[u]- Vander / lilleBror[/u]

notes.title: Retro Run v0.2.9
notes.content:
[h2]Retro Run v0.2.9[/h2]

[i][b][u]What's new?[/u][/b][/i]
- Added [b]AZERTY [/b]keyboard support [i](Thanks for the feedback Anon!)[/i]
- Added a option to change mouse sensitivity [i](Thanks for the feedback TeaDrinker!)[/i]

[i][b][u]What's fixed?[/u][/b][/i]
- Fixed an issue where the audio settings wouldn't save properly

[b][u][i]Q- How do I make azerty work?[/i][/u][/b]
[i]A- You get a pop-up menu when you launch the game, in that menu there is two buttons on the top, one that says "Qwerty -> Azerty" and one saying "Azerty -> Qwerty". These are quick switches, so if you click on Qwerty -> Azerty, all the keybinds will be changed to work with an Azerty keyboard and vice versa.[/i]

[i]Do you have any problem with these? bugs, glitches etc?
Please let me know, and I'll try my best to fix them![/i]

Hope you have an [b]awesome [/b]day/night!

Cheers!
- Vander / lilleBror

notes.title: Save System Update Info!
notes.content:
I'll be changing the current save system with a new and better one, that makes it so much easier to add new levels to the game! that means that your old save will be sacrificed for the new one, so I recommend not to play until it is out to not lose too much of your progress. The update will be out in not too long and I'll post another announcement when it is out.

Hope you guys understand my decision and that you aren't mad, Thanks again for the support!

- Vander

notes.title: Info #1
notes.content:
Hey, peeps!
I plan on updating the game with a few more levels, but before that time, I have to do back-end stuff, like remake certain systems etc. I also have to add that I have school, and there are a lot of tasks and things like that I have to prioritise! but I will still update the game with new things when I can :D
Thanks again for the support on the game!

- Vander :)

notes.title: THE GAME IS RE-RELEASED!
notes.content:
Retro Run is re-released in a new version that I have been developing behind the scenes!
I have worked on this version since I took down the store page back in November, and I can finally annouce it! Enjoy the game and please give feedback on what you like and don't like about it, The game is in Early Access so feedback is highly appreciated!

- Vander

notes.title: Sad news :(
notes.content:
Due to lack of motivation and just exhaustion, I will cancel Retro Run. I took on a much bigger project than I initially was thinking of when making the old Retro Run Builds. The game has become way too big for me to finish myself and I'm sorry about it.
I also lacked joy when making Retro Run Due to that I like to make more fun, childish games rather than the realistic approach I took with Retro Run.
Again, I'm so so sorry to the people who were excited about the game and were waiting for its release. Maybe one day...

I hope you guys will understand.

[h3][u][i]Note: I will not sell or give away keys for personal or curator use.[/i][/u][/h3]

notes.title: Why there is not buy feature anymore.
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

I have hidden the feature to buy Retro Run, this is because even though it is in early access, there was really not a lot of content in the current stage of the game. I will hide the feature to buy the game until I'm done with more content for you, the consumer to enjoy!
I'll post announcements on the Discord server to keep you guys updated on the progress and what features I add.
People who already bought the game can still play it.

Link to the Discord: https://discord.gg/ZZmVAUd

Thanks for your time!

- Vander

notes.title: Small patch
notes.content:
[b]Alpha 0.0.5[/b]

[b]Things changed:[/b]
[b]1.[/b] You no longer slide like crazy on the ground in platforms.
[b]2.[/b] The buttons for the different levels have been spaced out, so it doesn't look like one big button.

[b]Things added:[/b]
[b]1.[/b] A new help menu has been added! in platforms, go to the top right and click the question mark, this will bring you to a page where you see how key features work in the mode.
[b]2.[/b] Better controller support has been added to the game, I still work on trying to make the UI work with controllers.
